frame.name: Introduction
paragraphs: The maps illustrate the current layout of an industrial site and a proposed plan to transform it into a residential area.

frame.name: Overview
paragraphs: Overall, the site is planned to undergo a complete transformation from an industrial facility to a housing development, with all existing structures being replaced by residential buildings and communal amenities.

frame.name: Body 1
paragraphs: Currently, the industrial site is accessed via an entrance and reception area on Chimney Road to the north. The eastern side is dominated by a large factory adjacent to Pie Walk, while a circular parking area occupies the western side near Toe Lane. The southern portion contains a storage facility, six offices, and a canteen along Swallow Street, with a yard in the central space.

frame.name: Body 2
paragraphs: Under the redevelopment plan, the western side will feature a 3-bedroom house in the northwest corner and a 4-bedroom house in the southwest, both along Toe Lane. The central yard will be transformed into communal gardens with trees, bordered by a new private road, while parking garages will occupy the center-south area. On the eastern side, the factory will be replaced by an apartment block along Pie Walk, with a parking area added in the northeast corner. The northern section will accommodate three 2-bedroom houses along Chimney Road, where the entrance and reception currently stand. Finally, new private roads will be constructed to connect the residential properties and provide internal access throughout the development.
